covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the regular U.S. market close on Thursday, October 1, 2026, plus companies reporting before the next U.S. market open on Friday, October 2, 2026.

market_context_summary: The next session includes the September U.S. payroll report at 08:30 ET. Rate expectations, a high long-bond yield backdrop, and Nike-specific turnaround skepticism can amplify the reaction. No qualified Friday pre-market reporter was identified.

methodology.consensus_basis: Arithmetic mean of three independently formed direction scores and reversal-risk values.
methodology.disparity_definition: Average of the direction-score range normalized to 0-100 and the reversal-risk range; 0 means identical pass outputs and 100 represents maximum dispersion.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Existing expectation-bar, key-metric, forward-look, and reversal-risk controls applied. No new method change.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Global sales trajectory and fiscal Q2 outlook
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Existing forward-look and expectation-bar controls applied; no new method change.
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Deteriorating channel checks and negative estimate revisions make a downside reaction more likely, but the stock's sharp de-rating creates high relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is approximately $0.44 EPS and $11.3-$11.45 billion revenue, with revenue expected to decline about 3% year over year.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: A clean sales beat, stable gross margin, better North America wholesale sell-through, or less-bad China and fiscal Q2 commentary could trigger a sharp relief rally.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A sales miss, persistent Direct and China weakness, or fiscal Q2 commentary below consensus would reinforce the delayed-turnaround thesis.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options sources indicated an approximately 8.1%-8.3% implied earnings move; the roughly 49% one-year share-price decline and near-52-week-low setup increase squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: UBS cut its target and expected a five-cent EPS miss with fiscal Q2 EPS below consensus; BofA downgraded to Underperform and cut its target to $30; Stifel reduced FY2027 and FY2028 EPS estimates.

key_sources.title: UBS target cut and channel checks

excluded_names.reason: Absolute direction score exceeded 30, but consensus reversal risk of 68 exceeded the 40 maximum.

detailed_company_sections.pass_agreement: Unanimous Lean Down with low disparity; disagreement was mainly about the strength of the relief-rally risk.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Revenue and commentary broadly validate the delayed recovery, producing a modest negative reaction.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: The low bar is cleared, North America wholesale offsets Direct weakness, and fiscal Q2 commentary triggers a relief rally.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Sales miss and softer fiscal Q2 expectations deepen concern about China, Direct demand, and earnings recovery.
